questions.question: How does a servo bend a finger in a tendon-driven hand?
questions.answer: A line (tendon) runs from the fingertip to the servo horn; the servo turns and pulls the line, which curls the finger. Elastic or a return line straightens it.
rubric: Finger curls; a return force opens it

questions.question: A finger only half-curls even when the servo goes to its far angle. Name two likely mechanical causes.
questions.answer: The line is too slack or the servo horn is too small or mounted on the wrong tooth; a knot has slipped. Re-tension the line or remount the horn.
questions.hint: Both are about how far the line is pulled.

questions.question: Why does each finger need its own open and closed angle instead of one shared pair of numbers?
questions.answer: Each servo, horn and line is slightly different, so the angle that fully opens or closes one finger differs from another; calibration finds each pair.
questions.hint: No two fingers are built identically.

questions.question: Given int openAngle[5] = {20, 25, 30, 20, 15}; what is openAngle[2] and what is the last valid index?
questions.answer: openAngle[2] is 30 (counting starts at 0); the last valid index is 4.

questions.question: Write pointHand() so that only the index finger (finger 1) is open and the others are closed, using setFinger(i, open).
questions.answer: void pointHand() { for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { setFinger(i, i == 1); } }
questions.hint: A test i == 1 gives true for one finger only.

questions.question: What is the advantage of calling closeHand() instead of writing the five servo writes in loop()?
questions.answer: A name says what happens, it is written once, and later (typed or voice commands) call the same function.
questions.hint: Next lessons will call it from different places.

questions.question: After calibration the thumb closes in the wrong direction (it opens when told to close). What is the fix?
questions.answer: Swap that finger's open and closed angle values in the arrays; the servo is mounted in the opposite direction.
questions.hint: Only the numbers need to change.
